articles.title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address
articles.snippet: An MEV bot known as “Yoink” front-ran an attacker attempting to exploit a custom Safe module, capturing the stolen rsETH before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.

articles.title: Balancer eyes wind-down after restructuring fails to revive revenue
articles.snippet: Balancer cut costs and shipped new products after restructuring, but Marcus Hardt says v3 failed to replace legacy revenue as November’s $128 million exploit continued to weigh on adoption.

articles.title: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
articles.snippet: Crypto wallet providers must submit an early vulnerability report within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours of exploits, or risk administrative fines of as much as $17.3 million.
